options.name: Progression Balancing
options.doc:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_html:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

options.doc_fr:

Un réglage plus bas signifie qu'il reste coincé. Un réglage plus élevé signifie moins se coincer.

options.name: Accessibility
options.doc:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.

options.name: Goal
options.doc:
When is your world considered finished.
Easy: Requires completing the "normal" ending by reaching 6-4 and defeating Tiamat
Hard: Requires completing the "hard" ending by reaching 7-4 and defeating Hundun
CO: Requires reaching a specified level in Cosmic Ocean

options.name: Cosmic Ocean Goal Level
options.doc:
Which level in Cosmic Ocean are you required to clear to consider your game as beaten.
This option can be ignored if your goal is not set to "CO"

options.name: Ironman Goal mode
options.doc: Cannot enter goal level unless you started your run from the world start (Not using a shortcut)
options.doc_fr: Impossible d'entrer le niveau de but à moins que vous n'ayez commencé votre course depuis le début du monde (pas d'utiliser un raccourci)

options.name: Death Link
options.doc: When you die, everyone who enabled death link dies. Of course, the reverse is true too.
options.doc_html: When you die, everyone who enabled death link dies. Of course, the reverse is true too.
options.doc_fr: Quand vous mourez, tous ceux qui ont permis la mort meurent. Bien sûr, l'inverse est vrai aussi.
options.doc_html_fr: Quand vous mourez, tous ceux qui ont permis la mort meurent. Bien sûr, l'inverse est vrai aussi.

options.name: Death Link Ankh Handling
options.doc: Sets whether deaths sent through Death Link will trigger the Ankh, or ignore it.

options.name: Death Link Amnesty
options.doc: How many times YOU can die before you send a Deathlink out to the multiworld.

options.name: Death Link Grace
options.doc: How many times OTHERS in the multiworld die before YOU get killed.

options.doc: Should the Journal Entry of an item be required for its Item/Waddler upgrade to take effect?

options.name: Increase Starting Wallet
options.doc:
Should treasure (gold/emerald/sapphire/ruby/diamond) you receive from other players
increase the amount of gold you begin with after death.

options.name: Starting Characters
options.doc:
Characters that are immediately selectable. Adding more or less to this will adjust how many character locations you need to visit.
Normally unlocked characters (Ana/Margaret/Colin/Roffy) will show up in shopkeeper locked cages if a hired hand would be there -OR- in Vlad's Castle
If you do not specify ANY then Ana will be the only unlocked character
Options: 
- Alto Singh | Ana Spelunky | Au | Classic Guy | Coco Von Diamonds | Colin Northward | Demi Von Diamonds | Dirk Yamaoka | Guy Spelunky | Lise Project
- Little Jay | Liz Mutton | Manfred Tunnel | Margaret Tunnel | Nekka the Eagle | Pilot | Princess Airyn | Roffy D. Sloth | Tina Flan | Valerie Crump
options.doc_fr:
Caractères immédiatement sélectionnables. Ajouter plus ou moins à cela ajustera le nombre d'emplacements de personnages que vous devez visiter.
Les caractères normalement déverrouillés (Ana/Margaret/Colin/Roffy) apparaîtront dans les cages verrouillées d'un commerçant si une main louée était là -OU- dans le château de Vlad Si vous ne spécifiez Any alors Ana sera le seul caractère déverrouillé Options:
- Les diamants de Coco Von de Colin Northward de Demi Von de Dirk Yamaoka de Guy Spelunky
- Petite Jay, Liz Mutton, Tunnel de Manfred, Margaret, Nekka, l'aigle, Pilote Princess Airyn, Roffy D. Sloth, Tina Flan, Valerie, Crump

options.name: Progressive Worlds
options.doc:
Progressive worlds are unlocked in order:
Volcana, Jungle, Olmec's Lair, Tide Pool, Temple, Ice Caves, Neo Babylon, Sunken City, Cosmic Ocean.
Set this to 'false' to unlock worlds individually.

options.name: Shortcut Mode
options.doc:
Should shortcuts unlock as you gain worlds, or instead receive them from the multiworld
(You still the associated world for the shortcut to be open when you receive it from the multiworld)

options.name: Must Visit World
options.doc:
Must actually visit the world for the first time through normal gameplay before
a shortcut door will be available (this is in addition to your 'Shortcut Mode' setting)

options.name: Enable Traps
options.doc: Whether traps should be included in the item pool.

options.name: Trap Percentage
options.doc: Determines the percentage of filler items that will be replaced by traps.

options.name: Poison Trap Weight
options.doc:
Sets the likelihood of a trap being a Poison Trap relative to other traps.
Poison Traps will instantly poison the player.

options.name: Curse Trap Weight
options.doc:
Sets the likelihood of a trap being a Curse Trap relative to other traps.
Curse Traps will instantly curse the player.

options.name: Ghost Trap Weight
options.doc:
Sets the likelihood of a trap being a Ghost Trap relative to other traps.
Ghost Traps will immediately spawn the ghost (or Jelly if in Cosmic Ocean).

options.name: Stun Trap Weight
options.doc:
Sets the likelihood of a trap being a Stun Trap relative to other traps.
Stun Traps wll stun the player for 1 second.

options.name: Loose Bombs Trap Weight
options.doc:
Sets the likelihood of a trap being a Loose Bombs Trap relative to other traps.
Loose Bombs Traps will spawn 1 lit bomb at the player's feet every second for 5 seconds.

options.name: Blindness Trap Weight
options.doc:
Sets the likelihood of a trap being a Blindness Trap relative to other traps.
Blindness traps will trigger a darkness effect similar to the "I can't see a thing!" level
feeling for the current level.

options.name: Punish Ball Trap Weight
options.doc:
Sets the likelihood of a trap being a Punish Ball Trap relative to other traps.
Punish Ball Traps will attach a ball and chain to the player for 3 levels.

options.name: Amnesia Trap Weight
options.doc:
Sets the likelihood of a trap being an Amnesia Trap relative to other traps.
This trips you over and sends you back to the beginning of the level

options.name: Angry Shopkeeper Trap Weight
options.doc:
Sets the likelihood of a trap being Angry Shopkeepers relative to other traps.
Proto shopkeepers will show up at the start and exits
